Dear Customer,
We hope this email finds you well. We would like to inform you that our team has successfully completed the service visit for your swimming pool today. We appreciate your continued trust in our services.
We have attached the service report for your reference. The report contains details of the work performed, chemicals levels during the service visit and added chemicals.
We kindly remind you that regular servicing plays a vital role in keeping your swimming pool in optimal condition.
If you have any issue, kindly contact our service department on 1804666, and they will assist you accordingly.
Best regards,
